inclusive_limit.note: Presented as an off-by-one cleanup that 'fills chunks up to exactly chunk_size'; it starts a new chunk one character early, so chunks that should reach chunk_size are split differently.

bom_only_filter.note: Runs the non-printable filter only when a line starts with an invisible character (the byte-order-mark case the tests cover); tabs and other non-printable characters inside lines are now kept, which changes chunk text.

resum_total.note: Presented as making the running total 'drift-proof' by recomputing it from the window after every pop; same output, but it re-measures the whole window each time, which is more work.
